author: 鳴神 迅

prediction.question: 次に何が起きる？

en.title: Neon Strike: Ghosts of the Boundary
en.premise: A low-life runner in the undercity stumbles upon a mysterious chip known as the 'Secret Map.' It holds the coordinates to a sanctuary capable of forcibly resetting all human consciousness to reclaim true freedom. Hunted by the city's controlling AI and ruthless corporate armies, he plunges into a desperate race toward the furthest reaches of cyberspace alongside a cynical combat android.

zh.title: 霓虹打击：境界线的亡灵
zh.premise: 身为下层跑者的主人公，在某日回收了一枚名为『秘密地图』的神秘芯片。其中记载着一条前往圣域的路线，而该圣域能够强制初始化全人类的意识，从而夺回真正的自由。在统治城市的管理AI与企业军队的追击下，他与一名毒舌的战斗机器人一起，投身于一场前往电脑空间尽头的逃亡之战。
